entries.clue: Fleshy succulent rolled out in mats to make a living roof on a shed
Pipe at the back belching fumes, its rattle a certain MOT failure
Overtake on the inside, which the Highway Code plainly forbids
Yellow trumpet flower, a Welsh emblem worn proudly on St David's Day
Drug in the seven-per-cent solution injected as one novel opens
Landlady who climbs seventeen steps with the breakfast tray to the lodgers
Jointed living fossil of a weed, its roots plunging far below a spade's reach
Predicted arrival time, ticking later with every mile of stopped traffic
One of four spikes on a digging fork, driven in to aerate a lawn
Persian footwear at 221B whose toe end served the smoker as a pouch
Sewer rodent; the giant Sumatran one belongs to a tale Holmes never told
Spreader with an amber beacon, out salting the northbound side before dawn
